question: Neutrons are present in the nucleus of all atoms EXCEPT in those of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**hydrogen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hydrogen** was discovered by **Henry Cavendish** in **1766**.
 
• Hydrogen is the only atom that does not have **neutrons**.
 
• **Hydrogen** is the **lightest element** and is the** first element in the periodic table**.
 
• **Hydrogen** has **three isotopes**
 
 
• **Protium** **(₁H¹) **has **Zero neutron** present in its nucleus**.**</l
